comparison.objective: Place joint strips in an L-shaped slab to divide it into near-square rectangular panels.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan and position long strips according to slab geometry.
comparison.success_condition: All resulting panels are near-square rectangles; exact tolerances are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Layout planning and strip placement do not test impact fracture, recessed mandrel stabilization, coil protection, or fragment recovery.
